# RTL shaping core

Source: https://github.com/pnarimani/RTLTMPro
Commit: `f480419bbbffed1be3c129d68cc0182afcfbcac3`.
License: MIT, retained in LICENSE.txt and the in-game third-party notices.

Only the pure shaping helpers and Types are included. RTLTextMeshPro, editor/sample UI, and bundled sample fonts are excluded. TowTrouble.Rtl is a separate engine-free assembly. RecoveryLocalization.Shape uses this core with the original rich-text and digit-preservation options; TMP handles final right-to-left layout. Latin-only names and numeric values remain left-to-right.
